# findstr.exe is all Rust (findstr-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/findstr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# findstr.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/findstr-rust/src/findstr/findstr.rs)
add_cargo_module(findstr findstr-cargo findstr.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE findstr-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
